verdict.rationale: Runloop's own Axons let agents in Devboxes suspend when idle and wake on demand, and benchmark jobs run end-to-end without supervision. That shows background, autonomous agent execution, but only as on-demand or one-off runs. There is no documented user-facing automation setup with recurring schedules or triggers. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automation (cron-style triggers), documented event-trigger configuration for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: They give agents a persistent event stream that lets them suspend when idle, wake on demand, recover state, and hand off between agents — without you building the plumbing.
